title: 第25章 一爪黑龙第26章 蝉螳螂黄雀
lines: 驱妖师是一类能够驱使妖兽的武者。
这样的人十分少见，需要天生亲近妖兽，能够与妖兽沟通，并且修习驱妖术，凝聚出驱妖印才行！
与之相比，就是符师和药师都不算稀有了，难度要更大！
当然这是入门的难易，若是修到顶尖，却都是极为艰难的，没有难易之分。
林辰的确没想到会在这里遇到驱妖师。
他长这么大，遇到的驱妖师屈指可数，边军有三个，各大门阀或许有培养那么一两个。
其余则是皇族。
边军的驱妖师责任重大，需要镇守边关，驱使妖兽进行巡视等，不可能来到这里。
那这个驱妖师，可能是来自于各门阀，或者是隶属于皇室！
林辰心头顿时警惕起来。
皇室底蕴无比深厚，他们培养的驱妖师非常强大，其中一位，更是位列大驱妖师的行列，能够驱使五品妖兽！
是个非常危险的人物。
如果在这里的驱妖师是那一位，那林辰现在就可以转身离开了。
那个人残暴无比，杀人不需要理由，林辰并不想现在碰上。
“这红眼黑蛇是三品妖兽，唔，三星，并不弱了”
，林辰心中低语，隐在暗处并没有出来。
他仔细观察红眼黑蛇的动向。
“动作有些微迟缓，看来驾驭能力还不够高，应该不是那个大驱妖师”
，林辰心中略微松了口气。
不是那人的话，还有余地。
但林辰此刻也只是心中多了一个小心，戒备着，并不打算打草惊蛇。
在不确定对手身份之前，林辰可不想接触驱妖师。
避开这条甬道，林辰往另一边而去。
夜晚妖兽出没，很快林辰就遇到了一头外出狩猎的妖蛇，浑身花斑，脑袋三角，脖子细长，有一条极为醒目的猩红纹路贯穿头顶。
一看就是剧毒的妖蛇！
“红顶花斑蛇”
，林辰眸光一闪。
这种蛇剧毒，只需一滴毒液就可以让千钧境巅峰的武者在短时间内死亡。
它正在岩壁上爬行，在搜寻人气。
而林辰从暗处出现，他是猎杀者的猎杀者。
天钨出手，无声无息之中，红顶花斑蛇的脑袋被斩了下来。
直接死亡。
快速挑出妖丹，林辰想了想，俯身下去将红顶花斑蛇的毒囊小心的割离了下来。
这毒很厉害，而毒这种东西往往是以弱胜强的绝佳手段！
小心的收好毒囊，林辰将妖丹丢给了黑龙吞噬。
可惜不是上位血脉，并没能得到特殊的力量，不过天钨的确更凝实了。
继续前进，林辰对其它的不在意，来此地最重要的就是猎杀蛇类妖兽。
不断深入洞窟，林辰遇到了不少出来活动的妖兽。
而此地不愧是蛇窟，蛇类妖兽的确很多，大约一个时辰的时间林辰已经猎杀了超过十条蛇！
其中一条更是血脉强大，额头上已经有了突起，有化蛟的趋势。
只可惜到底是没有走到那一步。
也没有之前那银角三尾蛇的运气，得到灵药等，无法完成跨越，血脉并未得到升华。
不过那一枚妖丹，已经抵得上四品妖兽的妖丹了。
黑龙吞噬之后，形态上已经进一步凝实，一块块鳞片闪烁着光泽，好像实质一般！
龙角龙须，深沉凶戾的龙目，若是别人看到只怕会认为林辰身上有一条真正的黑龙！
content_en:
An exorcist is a type of warrior who can control monsters.
Such people are very rare. They need to be naturally close to monsters, be able to communicate with monsters, practice the art of exorcism, and condense the demon exorcism seal!
In comparison, even the Talisman Master and the Medicine Master are not rare, and are even more difficult!
Of course, it is difficult to get started, but if you reach the top, it will be extremely difficult. There is no difficulty.
Lin Chen really didn't expect to meet an exorcist here.
As he grew up, he met only a handful of demon exorcists. There were three in the border army, and each of the major clans might have trained one or two.
The rest are royalty.
The demon exorcists of the border army have a heavy responsibility. They need to guard the border, drive the demon beasts to patrol, etc., so it is impossible to come here.
Then this exorcist may come from various clans or belong to the royal family!
Lin Chen suddenly became wary.
The royal family has an extremely deep background, and the demon exorcists they trained are very powerful. One of them is even ranked among the great demon exorcists and can control fifth-level demon beasts!
He is a very dangerous person.
If the exorcist here was that one, then Lin Chen could turn around and leave now.
That man was extremely cruel and didn't need a reason to kill. Lin Chen didn't want to meet him now.
"This red-eyed black snake is a third-grade monster. Well, it's three-star. It's not weak anymore."
, Lin Chen whispered in his heart, hiding in the darkness and not coming out.
He carefully observed the movements of the red-eyed black snake.
"The movements are a little slow. It seems that the control ability is not high enough. He should not be the great exorcist."
, Lin Chen was slightly relieved.
If it's not that person, there is still room.
But at this moment, Lin Chen was just cautious and on guard, not intending to alert the enemy.
Lin Chen didn't want to come into contact with the exorcist before he was sure of his opponent's identity.
Avoiding this corridor, Lin Chen went to the other side.
Monsters appeared at night, and soon Lin Chen encountered a monster snake that was out hunting. It was covered in spots, with a triangular head, a slender neck, and a very eye-catching scarlet line running through the top of its head.
At first glance, it looks like a poisonous snake!
"Red-capped piebald snake"
, Lin Chen’s eyes flashed.
This kind of snake is extremely venomous, and just one drop of venom can kill a warrior at the peak of the Qianjun Realm in a short period of time.
It is crawling on the rock wall, searching for popularity.
And Lin Chen appeared from the darkness, he was the hunter of hunters.
Tiantung took action, and without any sound, the head of the red-crested spotted snake was chopped off.
Direct death.
Quickly picking out the demon pill, Lin Chen thought for a moment, leaned down and carefully cut off the venom sac of the red-capped piebald snake.
This poison is very powerful, and poison is often an excellent way for the weak to defeat the strong!
After carefully putting away the poison bag, Lin Chen threw the demon pill to the black dragon to swallow it.
It's a pity that he is not of high-level bloodline and cannot gain special power, but Tiantungsten is indeed more solid.
Moving on, Lin Chen didn't care about anything else. The most important thing here was to hunt snake monsters.
As he continued to go deeper into the cave, Lin Chen encountered many monsters that were out and about.
And this place is indeed a snake cave. There are indeed many snake monsters. Lin Chen has hunted more than ten snakes in about an hour!
One of them has a powerful bloodline, and there is already a protrusion on his forehead, and he has the tendency to turn into a dragon.
It's a pity that it didn't get to that point.
He didn't have the luck of the silver-horned three-tailed snake before. He got the elixir and so on, but couldn't complete the leap, and his bloodline didn't get sublimated.
But that demon elixir is already worth the demon elixir of a fourth-grade demon beast.
After being swallowed by the black dragon, the form has further solidified, and the scales are shining with luster, as if they are solid!
Dragon horns, dragon beards, and deep and ferocious dragon eyes. If others saw it, they would probably think that Lin Chen had a real black dragon on him!
